about: Governor contests of 1977, an odd year, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds. Built by pipeline/intake/build_congress.py from Cha, Kuriwaki and Snyder (2007-2021), Algara and Amlani's county returns (before, and where Cha lacks a contest), Louisiana's Secretary of State (2023) and New Jersey's and Virginia's certified results (2025), as each contest's source block says. The forecast is the governors' route fitted on the even years before it (data/congress/REPORT.md section 8).
